WINDOWS · 0.9.0 PREVIEW

On your computer

Install DeviceBridge, then choose Control this PC from Android. The installer includes the app runtime.

Download Windows installer

Windows 10/11 · x64 · About 268 MiB
Updates the installed app; local Windows sharing stays available.

ANDROID · 0.9.0 PREVIEW

On your phone

Install the Android companion and open DeviceBridge. It will ask for the connection key shown on your PC.

Download Android app

Android 8 or newer · About 3.1 MB
APK preview, signed for app updates. It is not on Google Play yet.

Pair once. Approve on your PC.

  1. Get your key

    On Windows, choose what to share and tap Generate connection key.

  2. Enter six characters

    Type that key into the Android app. There are no router settings or server addresses to enter.

  3. Allow your phone

    On the PC, review the request and tap Allow this phone. Trusted reconnect is optional.

Closing or minimizing the Windows preview keeps it in the tray. Use Stop remote sharing or Disconnect and quit from its tray menu to stop. The PC must be awake and online.

What we are testing

Native Windows screen viewing, multilingual typing, queued text and disconnect cancellation passed local controller tests. Android installation, separate-network access, audio, phone microphone, long sessions and outage recovery still need physical-device acceptance.

Some networks may prevent a direct connection; a relay is not configured yet. The free preview service can take a minute to wake up. This preview is separate from the stable 0.8.0 Windows release.

The Windows app is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may show a publisher warning. Android may ask whether to allow installing this APK. Keep system protections enabled; do not continue if your security software blocks it. Microphone routing uses the included VB-CABLE setup and may require a restart.
